display_information.name: Pollito
display_information.description: Team polls with automatic closing, live progress bars, and zero fees
display_information.long_description:
Pollito is a native Slack app for team polls and fast consensus without messy message threads.

Key Capabilities:
• Public or Anonymous Ballots: Create open polls with visible votes, or switch on anonymous voting so teammates can participate honestly without social pressure.
• Automatic Closing: Set a quorum target (such as 70% of channel members) or a deadline timer. The poll closes and announces the final result the moment consensus is reached.
• Live In-Channel Meters: Real-time vote counts and monospace progress bars updated directly in the message card.
• Channel Flexibility: Launch instant polls from any channel with /pollito or schedule them from the App Home.
• Zero Cost: Unlimited polls, votes, and team members with no subscriptions.

slash_commands.description: Create a team poll with automatic closing
